Brand and Format GateLink

Check ItemStatusNotes
Approved UNYRA logo or signature block used
Document header looks premium, clean, and corporate
Naming is explicit and institution-grade
Dates, references, and version labels are consistent
Tone reads formal and controlled, not casual

Content and Reference GateLink

Check ItemStatusNotes
Recipient and copied parties are correct
Subject and action required are explicit
Linked deal, shipment, or compliance references are correct
Movement posture and live-gate references are correct if relevant
Attached documents are final and approved for release
No outdated draft or superseded file is included

Counterparty Readiness GateLink

Check ItemStatusNotes
Packet is appropriate for the recipient stage and decision needed
Confidentiality level is appropriate
Required response deadline is explicit
Escalation path is clear if no response arrives
Internal owner is assigned after release

Containment and Movement GateLink

Check ItemStatusNotes
Current movement posture matches executable-check, scenario, risk, and live gate
Outward language does not imply broader release than current control answer
Current stop rule is explicit if movement is constrained
Next safe movement is explicit if a narrow step is still allowed
Revalidation owner and trigger are clear before any wider wording

Delivery Channel GateLink

Check ItemStatusNotes
Correct sending mailbox will be used
Attachments open and render properly
PDF or export formatting is clean if applicable
File names are clean for customer or supplier review
Release record will be saved back to the live folder
